title: A game/tool that allows you to make your own game/world in just 5 minutes. Looking for playtesters!
author: PodrickPayn3

comments.body: Join our discord server to access our early alpha and start creating! [https://discord.gg/rEJmwSWHNG](https://discord.gg/rEJmwSWHNG)

comments.author: GPTBuilder
comments.body: Looks kind of janky but like in a charming way. Looking charming this early with a wild idea like this is impressive. Do you all have a github or website with more info.

replies.author: PodrickPayn3
replies.body:
thanks! 

Yes it's in very early stage and we are adding more mechanisms to the app.

We don't have a website yet but you can learn more and try it for yourself in our discord server  [https://discord.gg/rEJmwSWHNG](https://discord.gg/rEJmwSWHNG)

comments.author: cantbebothered67836
comments.body:
Wow AI is just a tool for people without painting talent to realize their artistic vision, right guys? That's what people keep telling me, it's just a tool for otherwise talented people full of great ideas to sidestep all those smug and entitled artists to follow their dreams! It's basically an accessibility feature! Puppies! 

Well this doesn't look like a technology that turns achievement and human creativity into more idle consumerism at all!
